nom: Vibriance Super C Vitamin C Serum for Mature Skin

avis.texte: I had read a review that the product did not extend through the whole container, but I did not find that too surprising. What I did find surprising was just have little of the container actually contained product. Once the pump stops working, I usually take the top off to see if there is some left that can be reached and used. Well, I did just that this morning and what I found was unexpected, to say the least! Nearly 2/3 of the container is just that - CONTAINER. Empty container. It's 1 thing to provide a small bottle and you know what you have. Instead you're given a "weight." There is no way to determine how much product is in "1 oz" or how far it will go, how long it will last. This is a marketing tactic used constantly by many different products, but I find specifically with make up/skin care. This, however, of all the cosmetic products I have used over the years (and there have been many, I assure you!) is the worst! The product fills only of the actual container about 1/2". The smell is awesome, and maybe my skin feels a little smoother, but the it does not do what it proposes and if you considered how much of the product you receive in this container vs. a jar of another - well, you are probably paying more for this stuff. I can find that citris scent elsewhere for a lot less. I will not be buying this again! Note - tried to upload a picture, but could not get it to upload. If I can, I will edit at a later time. 3/10/24 While I still feel this is pricey for the amount
Have used for a week, so far loving it! It is very moisturizing, smells wonderful and a small amount covers my face & neck. Has simplified my skin care routine. High quality product!

I received this product two days ago and used it before bed and then twice yesterday, morning and night. I’ve used it again this morning. I love the fragrance, and so far it hasn’t bothered my super sensitive skin. My skin appears and feels moisturized but it soaks in quickly. I’m only giving it four stars right now because I haven’t used it enough to determine if it will be enough to continuously keep my dry skin moisturized all day. I will come back in a couple of weeks and update my review. Hopefully it will go up to five stars!! Update: I LOVE THIS STUFF!! It has become my only product I am using and my face feels softer and more moisturized than it has in years!!

By far the best serum on the market! I love that it makes my skin feel so soft. It has also helped with my skin tone and my fine line wrinkles. It doesn’t just sit on the top of my face and neck but soaks in and leaves my skin brighter and Dewey. I recommend trying Vibrance C . I have been a customer for over 8 years! That’s how good it makes my skin feel and look!

avis.titre: Best serum for reducing dark age spots!
avis.texte: I love this serum for reducing dark age spots. It seemed to lighten them within just a couple of weeks. I use it on my face, neck and chest and like how it goes on light and covers. You don’t need a lot, use it sparingly. When I bought it the first time I put it on too generously and used it up in no time. I was delighted when it became a Prime Day Deal, as it is a bit expensive, but well worth every penny.

Haven’t been using it for very long but I like the way it feels on my skin. It absorbs quickly and while hasn’t seemed to help my under eye bags a lot, I can already start to see a difference in my skin. It is helping to lighten my dark spots and blur my large pores. My face looks a little smoother and a little tighter. I’m 78 years old so I don’t expect a miracle, but I like what I’m seeing and feeling.

avis.titre: Smells great I'd say it's grapefruit scented

Do not expect instant results. Vitamin C gently exfoliates the skin. After I used Vibrance for several months, people started complimenting me on how pretty my skin looked; that my skin was glowing; and that I looked 20 years younger.

I have been using this for about 45 days and the change in my 74 year old skin is amazing. It feels so much softer and smoother. I was concerned about it only being 1 oz that it wouldn't last very long but I am still on my first bottle, I use 1 drop morning and night.

I would recommend it to everyone over fifty. It’s not a miracle Serum that works overnight. You have to have patience. First thing I found is how soft my skin is now. Can see the bags underneath my eyes disappearing. What I would like to know is how to purchase the sunscreen.
I like the smell of the product along with how it feels on my skin. As for the results I can’t really tell if it’s working it’s a little to soon it’s the first bottle.
Love this serum. Leaves skin hydrated and smooth. Product delivered promptly.

avis.titre: Super C & sunscreen and you’re good to go. So important!
avis.texte: This was my second order of Vibriance, so I don’t run out. It has everything in it I already use (in 5 different steps)! Unlike some of the ads, I’m not tossing the other products, just using alternately with Vibrance until they run out. I’ve been using Vit C, B & E for years (E in my sunscreen). So - I use Vibrance in the morning before my sunscreen. I only use Vibriance at night on nights I’m not using Tretinion (100% vit A prescription 0.05% strength). Vibriance is going to make packing and using on travels so much faster and easier; the main reason I ordered it in the first place. I love the texture- almost a gel but softer & smoother if that makes sense. I’ve had no irritation. My sunscreen goes on over it nicely as does any other moisturizer or makeup products I might use on a given day - I don’t need much! Another reason I decided to spend more on Vibriance (after buying a similar, cheaper product but made in China) is that it is a USA product. FYI I’m an active 80. No foundation on in these pics - just blush.

avis.titre: Not irritating! My 90 year old mom uses it.
avis.texte: My mom is English and has paper thin skin. She actually found this somehow and told me about a couple of years ago. Her skin is thin and sensitive and she has reactions all the time. But not with this. At all. It’s gentle and silky and I get complimented all the time with no make up on. It reflects light and has quality ingredients. I’ve been using this for several bottles now and I’m highly sus of the lower star reviews even tho there aren’t many. This stuff is miraculous. My pores even look smaller. They better never stop making it!

I saw this on Facebook and didn't have high hopes for it. I ordered it, thinking if I didn't like it, I could return it (Gotta love Amazon). Wow. I was very surprised at how much I did like it! Others said it took some time to show results, but I didn't find that to be the case. I saw reduction in the lines on my face and around my eyes, forehead, etc. within a couple of weeks. I put the product on my face when it's clean and dry and free from any other product. I let it absorb, then add a small amount of moisturizer and a small dab of skin rejuvenation from Il Makiage. I couldn't be happier. I sent the link to my 2 best friends and told them they need to buy it. Try it, I think you will be pleasantly surprised. I'm 58 and most people think I am in my mid 40's. The picture was taken 3 weeks ago after about 4 weeks of using the product. I am 58 and my daughter is 21.
Well worth money, one squirt is all needed. People cannot believe my age

Don't believe the hype. I bought this hoping it would help with my smoker lines around my mouth, no help whatsoever. The only good thing I can say about it was I liked the smell, orange citrus. I used the whole bottle hoping I would see some difference but nothing happened. Save your money.

avis.titre: It might be working… It’s definitely not hurting!
avis.texte: I’m 56 years old, and I’ve been using this product faithfully for 2 months. As with anything like this, any improvement is going to be so gradual it’s hard to notice, unfortunately l don’t have any comparable before pics… but I will say this… in the last few weeks I’ve received several compliments on my skin! By nature I have Very Oily skin, and I was pleasantly surprised that it didn’t increase with this product. I did read all the reviews and I’ve never had any kind of bad reactions, I did see some reviews that said it dried their skin out… but the instructions clearly state that you can use your moisturizer after applying this… I usually apply my moisturizer about 3 to 5 minutes after letting my skin absorb this product! When you first put it on, a little bit goes a long way, and it feels greasy at first while applying, but give it a couple minutes and it absorbs right in! I love the way my skin feels!! It also smells really good too! My skin does feel a whole lot better since using it, and so far I really have no complaints!

I stopped using it and it took at least a week for my face to recover. I kept it for a few months and because I liked the fragrance and first results I tried it again and it did the same thing to my face. I have big water sacks under my eyes and my face is hot and burning. I have never had sensitive skin but this product is not for me.

I love the enrichment m skin has to regular use if this product. It looks healthy, fuller, and well maintained. It is a great underlined with my makeup as well. I have been using about three years and it my number one go to for my facial routine.

It’s rare when I find a skin product I can fully endorse but Vibrance is wonderful. My skin looks brighter and more firm. Love the fragrance too. Just applying it makes me feel better. I encourage everyone to try it. You’ll love it!!!

This was the difference in one day.... I cannot imagine what will happen in one week two weeks three weeks. The reason for four instead of five stars is this is very expensive. I would like all my friends and family to be able to afford it.

avis.titre: Great Texture; Absorbs Very Quickly; Concerns Over Concentrations, Lemon Water
avis.texte: The Vibrancec Super C Serum comes safety sealed with perforated plastic wrap and states it is made in the USA. The bottle is your standard 1oz plastic cylinder pump. I'm a hint disappointed with quality control on the askew label placement (per my included images), as it makes the product look cheap like they didn't care enough about it to make sure the label was straight. The serum has a light citrus scent, is cloudy, [otherwise] colorless, with a semi-thick gel-like in texture. Absorbs very quickly, leaving dry skin behind. Be sure to use a moisturizer and SPF after this. Ingredient list (per the product post): Lemon Fruit Water, Butylene Glycol, Cyclopentasiloxane, Dimethicone, PEG-8, Isododecane, Water, Polysilicone-11, 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, Sodium Hyaluronate, Glucomannan, Orange Peel Oil, Hexylresorcinol, Acetyl Glucosamine, Allantoin, Panthenol, Tocopheryl Acetate, Caffeine, Decyl Glucoside, Coco Caprylate/Caprate, Polyacrylate-13, Polyisobutene, Polysorbate 20, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Trihydroxystearin, Acrylates/ C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, PPG-12/SMDI Copolymer, Disodium EDTA, Triethanolamine. Does not have percentages or concentrations of vitamin C. The vitamin C is sourced from 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid. Ascorbic acid is a powerhouse antioxidant. 3-O ethylated ascorbic acid, also known as EA or EAA, depending on the reference, is an l-ascorbic acid, a derivative with an ethyl group at the third carbon position, hence the

avis.titre: BABY SMOOTH SKIN AND BYE-BYE WRINKLES
avis.texte: If you are in the market for some skin rejuvenation (aren't we all, regardless of age) then look no further. This Super C hydrating and lifting serum tackles wrinkles and skin resurfacing with ease, and even pigmentation/dark spot treatment in a 3-in-1 serum that produces visibly instantaneous results. I realize that results are mostly subjective for many reasons, but the effect on my face was superb. The handy pump bottle delivers a clear serum that glides smoothly over the face, smells lightly of orange citrus, and instantly made my skin as smooth as a baby. Lemon is the lst ingredient and obviously tackles pigmentation, along with orange peel. Both tackle wrinkles as well. The list of ingredients is recognizable, and I loved the fast penetration. It had a bit of an initial sting from the citrus, but no irritation of my sensitive skin, and the sensation faded away almost immediately. This is an excellent Vitamin C serum that offers "super" results, given the effect on my face. Sometimes I call out skincare companies for using the preservative "phenoxyethanol", which is somewhat controversial in Europe but not banned by the FDA in the U.S. for not being in sufficient quantity for alarm. It is important to note where it appears on a skincare/cosmetic ingredient list. My use of it would be more cautious if it appeared at or more toward the top of the list, but I'm not very concerned when it appears at or toward the bottom, which is reserved for the ingredients of less importan

I don't usually do reviews, but this stuff is amazing. I have been using this for quite some time, I'm on my 3rd order of the 3 pack. I'm 71 years old, I don't expect to look 30, but I'm extremely happy with the results. I use it twice a day.

I knew this probably wouldn't work for me when I read the ingredients and unfortunately saw things like silicones and ethylhexyl palmitate which will clog my pores and increase acne. The smell is also stronger then other vitamin c serums I've used - not necessarily unpleasant but smells like tang/orange drink. It went on well and it didn't irritate my skin at all but due to my issue with occasional break outs and clogged pores I probably won't continue using it. I might use it for my hands instead as they can also show signs of aging.

You can smell the citrus straight away. Still, it wasn't the first thing I noticed about this product. I ordered it because it came in a completely opaque container. This is very important for Vitamin C products since Vitamin C is destroyed by light. Anyone packaging their C product in a clear container is not selling you Vitamin C. Vit C is also destroyed by heat, so keep it cool- even in the fridge is good. So, yes, you can smell the citrus. It goes on smoothly and slightly tacky and it will tingle a little if you have any cuts/scrapes/blemishes on your face. This is normal for a Vit C product which also reassures me that this product has what it says it has in it. The best thing about this product is it gives you glowing skin. Basically a really healthy looking complexion. I've been using Vitamin C products for about 20 years now, and this stuff is the real deal, so you can purchase with confidence.

avis.titre: Used for almost 4 weeks with no visible results
avis.texte: The bottle arrived wrapped in plastic wrap with no instructions included. It went on smoothly, has a light, orange scent, and did not irritate my skin at all. I had high hopes for this serum. Unfortunately after 4 weeks of daily use, I have seen no visible results. I have included before and after photos. My dark spots, skin tone, and wrinkles seem unchanged to my untrained eye. Not worth the $$ for any minor results that might be accomplished with more time.

As many others have said, beware!. I used this product and my entire face and neck look like I had been burned. My eyes were swollen shut for two days. Multiple people have said this in their reviews. I am not sensitive to products, but this one was horrible. I don’t usually write a review for a product, but I’m doing this as a warning to other buyers. It seems to be an issue for many folks that purchased this product. Unless you want to visit to the ER or your doctor with severe burning, as well as your eyes swollen shut, don’t buy his product!

Hi, I used Vibriance C Serun that I bought at Amazon. The first one, my skin was amazing. I was very happy with the results. I bought the second one and it is horrible. Look how is my skin. It is burning. I used in the morning and now(5pm) I need to run home to wash my face because is itchy and burning. I can’t return because is more than 30 days after I bought it.
Used 1 time before bed. Woke up burning red all over my face & swollen. No idea what ingredient caused. Definitely returning.
